comparisons.comparison: Both companies explicitly discuss how the amortization expense related to acquired patents/intangibles impacted their financial metrics in fiscal 2024. QCOM attributes its QTL EBT margin expansion to a decrease in amortization expense related to acquired patents. AMD discloses that its amortization of acquisition-related intangibles decreased by 15% year-over-year to $2.4 billion, primarily due to certain intangibles being fully amortized. While QCOM focuses on the cost savings from this decrease boosting EBT margins, AMD focuses on the magnitude and reduction of the expense itself in its MD&A.
